typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		APPL_ID_CT as integer,
		USER_CT as integer,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME as string,
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		DB_OBJ_CT as integer,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM as integer,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB as double,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT as timestamp,
		TBL_CT as integer,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_QRY_DT as timestamp,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB as double,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		REC_CT as long,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID as long,
		ENCRYPT_CD as string,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT as integer,
		QRY_CT as long,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ADONETSource
ADONETSource sink(input(
		APPL_ID_CT as string,
		USER_CT as string,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		DB_OBJ_CT as string,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM as string,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT as string,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT as string,
		TBL_CT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as string,
		LAST_QRY_DT as string,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB as string,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		REC_CT as string,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID as string,
		ENCRYPT_CD as string,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT as string,
		QRY_CT as string,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		APPL_ID_CT,
		USER_CT,
		CNTCT_AU_NAME,
		RPT_DT,
		DB_OBJ_CT,
		CNTCT_AU_NUM,
		CURRENT_PERM_SPACE_GB,
		CNTCT_EMAIL_ADDR,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_CREATE_DT,
		LAST_TBL_DDL_ALTER_DT,
		TBL_CT,
		ENVRN_TXT,
		CREATE_DT,
		LAST_QRY_DT,
		MAX_PERM_SPACE_GB,
		PLTFM_TXT,
		DATABASENAME,
		REC_CT,
		CONTACT_EMP_ID,
		ENCRYPT_CD,
		NON_US_BASED_USER_CT,
		QRY_CT,
		CNTCT_FULL_NAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
